name: Pale Blue Blouse
description: Pale blue long-sleeved collared blouse with the top buttons open and sleeves rolled up. Thin steel collar with a drop pendant, medium skirt, executive-secretary look.

name: Panda Hoodie

name: Black Bunny Costume
description: Fitted black bunny costume with a rabbit-ear headband, white collar and cuffs, black bow tie and a fluffy tail. Dark sheer tights, black heels.

name: School Uniform
description: Camel-tan blazer over a cream sweater vest and white shirt, with a brick-red tie. Slate-blue pleated skirt, black tights, brown loafers and a small pink bunny hair clip.
